GSTIN-wise turnover band and GeM/CPPP tender awards were not retrievable (web_search backend down: "searx: Connection refused"; volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403), so GST band = null.
note: Manufacturer (own belt plants, Nagalwadi/Hingna MIDC, Nagpur per ImportKey address block) — role: manufacturer. Export shipments are factual, not claimed: dated India customs B/L records with destination and HS code, latest 2026-02-28 to Germany, plus UK, Philippines, Thailand and Ecuador (2025-09-30). Domestic supply is factual via audited listed-company turnover (Rs 593 cr FY2025, Rs 582 cr FY2026 consolidated) and a stated >80% own-brand after-sales model. Caveat on HS: declared codes 401031-401034 are V-belt subheadings; the customs lines seen carry 40103999 and 40169990, so the declared code set should be reconciled to the actual 40103999 belt lines — this is a code correction, not a rejection ground. Note the ImportKey free page mixes in unrelated import rows (Motorola, Humanscale) due to name matching; only the rows where PIX is the shipper were used. Revenue: Rs 582 cr (FY2026 consolidated, Screener.in); export volume split not public — null.
